items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: the rhythm section I think was Danny Alvin

ctx.x: And, of course, Nick's was always changing. And, I got to hear all these guys, and it happens that I was down at Nick's one night and I went in to see Brad Gowans' and he wasn't there and I didn't know exactly who was on the bandstand so I got in there and I noticed that it was George Brunis and PeeWee and the trumpet player's name was Marty Marsala - yeah - and, the rhythm section I think was Danny Alvin and, uh---
